name: d2-lim02-marker
description: S6 D2 / LIM-02 Bebelith marker DIAGNOSTIC CONTROL (not a pre-fix cold load; no admitted pre-v0.0.182 save carries the marker). The mark launch summons a real Bebelith, gives an armored disposable character the retired KMG.Summoning.Special.Bebelith.DismantledArmor buff exactly as v0.0.181 applied it (the Bebelith combat-traits context, null duration), runs native RuleCalculateAC without and with the marker, lets the Bebelith expire natively (deadline moved to now, disclosed), and saves. A fresh process loads that save and repeats the AC calculation. Predeclared: AC with the marker equals AC without; the marker component runs and adds no modifier; armor is unchanged; the marker remains exactly once and deserializes with its component.
